wwo.name: Cape Town
wwo.method: Selected surveyed street and land-use relationships along Bo-Kaap, central gardens, the former shore and the Woodstock railway edge. Parcel positions and building volumes are inferred along traced streets. Surveyed road alignments and mapped open ground are approximate. No inferred street coverage in unreadable gaps. Shoreline, docks and selected additional street corridors follow the separate circa 1900 municipal plan.

sources.licence: Historical geographic observations only. Municipality scan and service imagery excluded.
sources.precision: Municipal CRS84 rendering at 0.00002 degrees per pixel. Selected local centre lines and use boundaries read manually. Exact sheet dates, registration error, parcels and paving are unresolved.

sources.licence: Historical facts for regional form; original geometry generated locally.
sources.date: Heritage guidance covering the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries
sources.precision: Low terraces, shared street edge and compact flat or shallow-roofed houses; reference covers form, not individual 1900 dwellings.

sources.licence: Geographic observations only. Municipal raster omitted.
sources.precision: CRS84 export 0.00004 degrees per pixel. Historical harbour, street and shoreline positions are approximate. Survey date of each addition and tides are unresolved.
